I developed the Product Marketing and growth strategy from analytics to roadmap and through partnerships (Apple, Facebook, Messenger, Parrot). I focused on the business model (SaaS), growth through marketing (SEO, SEM, display) and partnerships (YouTube, DailyMotion, Google Apps). Stupeflix API (launched 2009) was the only self-serve developer platform to create video content at scale. 40M videos were created for developers (real estate, classifieds) and brands like RedBull, Sprint, Coke, Amex.
